examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Requests by country on the dotted network map, in five sequential steps from the lowest to the highest value. Focus the map and use the arrow keys to read each country, highest first.

examples.name: Points
examples.summary: Locations as bubbles whose area follows the value, for points of presence or cities.

examples.name: View
examples.summary: The map framed on one part of the world, with shaded countries and bubbles together.

examples.name: States
examples.summary: Loading holds the map footprint, empty says why nothing matched, error replaces the map with a danger Alert, and table view shows the accessible twin.
